title: BPW-2026-0564
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET LIGHTING]
BPW-2026-0564
CD 3, 8
INDEFEASIBLE RIGHT OF USE (IRU) – COMMUNITY CONNECTIVITY PILOTS BACKHAUL FIBER
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the Master Agreement and IRU-01 and IRU-02 between the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) and the Bureau of Street Lighting (BSL) for a 3-year term for BSL usage of LADWP dark fiber between the Public Works Building and Crenshaw Corridor and Canoga Park;
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the agreement; and
AUTHORIZE the BSL, Executive Director, or designee, to make any technical or accounting updates to the recommendations above to effectuate the intent of the Board of Public Works.
